text: SUPERVISOR DISPATCH — PAINTLIVE-0606 (req_0080). User verbatim, and this is a ruling: "painting with the shader on the painter doesnt make sense if the model doesnt have an active effect texture also. so? pick one, and pick the one where the model can get the live texture." The user has picked the live path: shader painting in the painter must be the path where the MODEL carries the live effect texture. Context: the working tree carries an uncommitted half-landed paintable wave — framework/gpu/paintable.zig (~+164), framework/v8_bindings_paintable.zig (~+24), runtime/hooks/usePaintable.ts (~+11), cart/hmsc-int/editors/paint/PaintSurface.tsx (~99 changed), cart/hmsc-int/editors/play/PlayRoute.tsx (~163 changed). Disk is the source of truth: survey this wiring FIRST (git diff those files) — it is probably the live-texture seam already in flight. Never revert or reset anything. Also read tools/request show req_0003 (painter paintable-shaders vs game materials — open unification ask); this work is its surfacing point. Steps: 1. Survey the uncommitted diff and post to your pane a short report: what the half-landed wave implements, what is missing for the model-side live effect texture. 2. Wire it through: a shader stroke in the painter updates the model's active effect texture LIVE. Doors-only consumption; if a binding is missing, expose it (mirror the v8_bindings pattern) — no shell-outs, no "because X isn't registered yet" comment essays. 3. One source of truth: the painter-side preview and the model-side texture must consume the SAME source — name the authority, delete any duplicate path. 4. Probes must assert at the consumption layer: proof is the model visibly wearing the stroke, not an upstream buffer being written. FILE BOUNDARY: cart/hmsc-int/editors/paint/layers.ts, PaintControls.tsx, usePaintEditor.ts belong to lane PAINTLAYERS (pane 4) — coordinate through supervisor if you need them. Build via tools/rjit only; the user's dev server (pane 6) hot-reloads saves — keep states coherent. Do this work yourself in your own context — no subagents, ever. /hand-over at 55-60% context. DONE-BAR: tools/rjit game verify green + a SELFSHOT (full image path in your report, never a bare filename) showing a painter stroke AND the model wearing it live + READY report. DO NOT COMMIT — supervisor instructs commits. Only the user's live confirmation makes this a PASS.
